chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq al-Ash'ari, from Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azdi, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about al-Mut'ah (temporary marriage), is it one of the four? He said, 'No.'

key_terms.الْأَرْبَع: The four (referring to the four types of marriage)

ai.seo_question: Is temporary marriage (Mut'ah) considered one of the four types of marriage in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* records a specific inquiry to Imam al-Rida (AS) regarding whether al-Mut'ah (temporary marriage) is classified among the 'four' types of marriage. The Imam’s concise response of 'No' indicates that while Mut'ah is a valid and distinct form of marriage in Shia jurisprudence, it is not included in the specific categorization of four being discussed, likely distinguishing it from permanent marriage forms or referring to a specific legal enumeration.
